messages:
alex: Huge thank you to infra + eng-sre for catching that memory leak during the lunch demo — seriously saved the session (and my hairline). :tada:
maya: absolute heroes. special nod to devin for the rollback and kevin for chasing the heap growth root cause. :heart:
devin: team effort! rollback was quick because charlie's old heap-dump script is a gift that keeps on giving. :pray:
charlie: hahaha that ancient script lives to serve. i'll bring donuts tomorrow as payment. :doughnut:
kevin: i'll match charlie with bagels. which office should i swing by? SF kitchen or downtown meeting area?
sophia: i can coordinate a small remote snack drop for distributed teammates — DM me shipping addresses and dietary notes. :package:
ops-bot: Deploy rollback executed by @devin at 12:47. Incident resolved at 12:55. :white_check_mark:
alex: also huge props to product & design for staying calm in the room. that made a huge difference.
maya: can we mention this as a quick kudos in the town hall? cross-team saves like this are great to highlight.
kevin: +1 town hall shout. also anyone want to nominate folks for the monthly Ripple award? i think devin + charlie qualify.
alex: nominating devin and charlie — blurb: "saved a customer demo via fast rollback and heap script; kept latency under control."
devin: mildly embarrassed, mostly flattered. :blush:
charlie: i'll bring extra coffee to go with the donuts. and i'll drop the heap script in the ops-playbooks channel for future rescue ops.
sophia: thanks everyone — i'll collect addresses and coordinate snacks. shipping cut-off is tomorrow 10am if anyone's remote and wants a treat.
alex: thanks again team. small win, big vibes. :raised_hands:
